```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

### Read in Data
```{r}
mergeDataStr <- paste0(getwd(), "/data/merged_data.csv")
mergeData <- read.csv(mergeDataStr)
```

### Filter Data to Power 5, Rename Columns
```{r}
p5Conf <- c("SEC", "P12", "ACC", "B10", "B12")

p5Data <- mergeData %>% 
  filter(Conf %in% p5Conf) %>% 
  rename(
    # Four Factors
    off_eFGPct = eFGPct.y,
    def_eFGPct = eFGPct.x,
    off_eFGPct_Rank = RankeFGPct.y,
    def_eFGPct_Rank = RankeFGPct.x,
    off_TOPct = TOPct.y,
    def_TOPct = TOPct.x,
    off_TOPct_Rank = RankTOPct.y,
    def_TOPct_Rank = RankTOPct.x,
    off_ORPct = ORPct.y,
    def_ORPct = ORPct.x,
    off_ORPct_Rank = RankORPct.y,
    def_ORPct_Rank = RankORPct.x,
    off_FTRate = FTRate.y,
    def_FTRate = FTRate.x,
    off_FTRate_Rank = RankFTRate.y,
    def_FTRate_Rank = RankFTRate.x,
    
    # Misc [Offense/Defense]
    off_FG2Pct = FG2Pct.x,
    def_FG2Pct = OppFG2Pct.x,
    off_FG2Pct_Rank = RankFG2Pct.x,
    def_FG2Pct_Rank = RankOppFG2Pct.x,
    off_FG3Pct = FG3Pct.x,
    def_FG3Pct = OppFG3Pct.x,
    off_FG3Pct_Rank = RankFG3Pct.x,
    def_FG3Pct_Rank = RankOppFG3Pct.x,
    off_FTPct = FTPct.x,
    def_FTPct = OppFTPct.x,
    off_FTPct_Rank = RankFTPct.x,
    def_FTPct_Rank = RankOppFTPct.x,
    off_BlockPct = BlockPct.x,
    def_BlockPct = OppBlockPct.x,
    off_BlockPct_Rank = RankBlockPct.x,
    def_BlockPct_Rank = RankOppBlockPct.x,
    off_FG3Rate = FG3Rate.x,
    def_FG3Rate = OppFG3Rate.x,
    off_FG3Rate_Rank = RankFG3Rate.x,
    def_FG3Rate_Rank = RankOppFG3Rate.x,
    off_ARate = ARate.x,
    def_ARate = OppARate.x,
    off_ARate_Rank = RankARate.x,
    def_ARate_Rank = RankOppARate.x,
    off_StlRate = StlRate.x,
    def_StlRate = OppStlRate.x,
    off_StlRate_Rank = RankStlRate.x,
    def_StlRate_Rank = RankOppStlRate.x,
    off_NSTRate = NSTRate.x,
    def_NSTRate = OppNSTRate.x,
    off_NSTRate_Rank = RankNSTRate.x,
    def_NSTRate_Rank = RankOppNSTRate.x
  ) %>% 
  select(-ends_with(".y"))
```

### Narrow in Data for PCA/K Means Clustering

```{r}
  select(-Conf, -seed) %>% 
  select(-ends_with("Rank")) %>% 
  select(-starts_with("Rank")) %>% 
  select(-DFP.x) %>% 
  select(-ends_with("rk"))

```

### Run PCA on offensive data
```{r}
# Run PCA for variable selection...

offensivePcaData <- offensiveData %>% select(-TeamName, -Season)

pca_result <- prcomp(offensivePcaData, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

summary(pca_result)
```

### Run K Means Clustering varying k to select using Elbow Method
```{r}
# Run K Means clustering for k = 1:n to produce elbow plot for number of cluster selection

set.seed(123)

n <- 25

offensiveDataCluster <- offensiveData %>% select(-TeamName, -Season)
off_scaled_cluster <- scale(offensiveDataCluster) %>% as.data.frame()

off_scaled <- bind_cols(
  offensiveData %>% select(TeamName, Season),
  off_scaled_cluster
)

wss <- numeric(n)

for (k in 1:n){
  km <- kmeans(off_scaled_cluster, centers = k, nstart = 20)
  
  wss[k] <- km$tot.withinss
}

wss_df <- tibble(clusters = 1:n, wss = wss)

elbow_plot <- ggplot(wss_df, aes(x = clusters, y = wss, group = 1))+
  geom_point(size = 2)+
  geom_line()+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, n, 2)) +
  xlab('Number of Clusters')+
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = wss,
    linetype = 'dashed'
  )

elbow_plot
```


### Run K-Means with selected k (centers), label observations w/ clusters
```{r}
km14 <- kmeans(off_scaled_cluster, centers = 14, nstart = 20)


offensiveData$FullCluster <- as.factor(km14$cluster)

off_scaled_df <- as.data.frame(off_scaled)
off_scaled_df$FullCluster <- as.factor(km14$cluster)
```


### Full Process: Variance Reduction Analysis for I.D. of Important Cluster Features
If there is a large variance reduction of a feature from the variance of that feature throughout all observations to the variance of the feature within a cluster, then we define that statistic to be a 'substantially variance reducing feature'.

```{r, fig.height=6}
clusterN <- 1

# Step 1: Grab a single clusters data
clusterNScaled <- off_scaled_df %>% 
  filter(FullCluster == clusterN) %>% 
  select(-FullCluster, -TeamName, -Season)

# Step 2: Calculate Centered Variance for each feature
cNVar <- 1 - sapply(clusterNScaled, var)

# Step 3: Sort the variances
cNVar_sorted <- sort(cNVar, decreasing = FALSE)

# Step 4: Convert to data frame for plotting
var_df <- data.frame(
  feature = factor(names(cNVar_sorted), levels = names(cNVar_sorted)),
  variance = as.numeric(cNVar_sorted)
)

# Step 5: Plot in Decreasing variance reduction
ggplot(var_df, aes(x = feature, y = variance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylab("Variance") +
  xlab("Feature") +
  ggtitle(paste("Feature Variance Decreases (Cluster", clusterN, ")", sep = " "))+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      angle = 0,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1) # Ensure x-axis labels are readable
  )
```

### Compare Each Avg. Stat within Cluster to All Data Stats
```{r}
var_df_sorted <- var_df %>% 
  arrange(-variance) %>% 
  filter(variance > 0)

var_reduced_stats <- var_df_sorted$feature

# Can change this to use offensiveData (for true values) and off_scaled_df (for normalized values)
var_reduced_values <- off_scaled_df %>% 
  select(all_of(var_reduced_stats), FullCluster)

clusterNValues <- var_reduced_values %>% 
  filter(FullCluster == clusterN)

nonClusterNValues <- var_reduced_values %>% 
  filter(FullCluster != clusterN)

clusterNAvgs <- clusterNValues %>% 
  group_by(FullCluster) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

nonClusterNAvgs <- nonClusterNValues %>% 
  summarise(
    across(-FullCluster, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

variance_reductions <- as.data.frame(t(setNames(var_df_sorted$variance, var_df_sorted$feature)))

clusterNTitle <- paste("Cluster", clusterN, sep = " ")
nonClusterNTitle <- paste("Non Cluster", clusterN, sep = " ")

comparisonTable <- bind_rows(
  clusterNAvgs %>% select(-FullCluster) %>% mutate(Type = clusterNTitle),
  nonClusterNAvgs %>% mutate(Type = nonClusterNTitle),
  variance_reductions %>% mutate(Type = "Variance Reduction")
) %>% 
select(Type, everything())

difference_row <- comparisonTable %>%
  filter(Type == clusterNTitle) %>%
  select(-Type) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  `-`(comparisonTable %>% filter(Type == nonClusterNTitle) %>% select(-Type) %>% as.data.frame())

comparisonTable <- bind_rows(
  comparisonTable,
  difference_row %>% mutate(Type = "Difference")
) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

comparisonTable

```

### Difference in Means Hypothesis Tests
Set Significance Level = 0.1

We define a feature (statistic) as a **'defining feature'** of a cluster if the feature is a 'substantial variance reducing feature' with a statistically significance difference in means between the data for that feature within that cluster, and the data for that feature for all other clusters.
```{r}
var_df_sorted <- var_df %>% 
  arrange(-variance) %>% 
  filter(variance > 0)

var_reduced_stats <- var_df_sorted$feature

var_reduced_values <- offensiveData %>% 
  select(all_of(var_reduced_stats), FullCluster)

clusterNData <- var_reduced_values %>% 
  filter(FullCluster == clusterN)

notClusterNData <- var_reduced_values %>% 
  filter(FullCluster != clusterN)

var_reduced_values <- var_reduced_values %>% 
  select(-FullCluster)

hypTestsResults <- data.frame(
  feature = character(),
  p_value = numeric(),
  t_stat = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (feature in var_reduced_stats) {
  # Get the data for the feature
  clusterN_values <- clusterNData[[feature]]
  notClusterN_values <- notClusterNData[[feature]]
  
  # Perform a t-test
  t_test_result <- t.test(clusterN_values, notClusterN_values)
  
  # Store the result (Feature, p-value, t-statistic)
  hypTestsResults <- hypTestsResults %>%
    add_row(
      feature = feature,
      p_value = round(t_test_result$p.value, 3),
      t_stat = round(t_test_result$statistic, 2)
    )
}

print(hypTestsResults)
```

### Curate data for polygon plot
```{r}
# Should use off_scaled_df above to make comparisonTable for this step!
comparison_data_long <- comparisonTable %>%
  filter(Type != "Variance Reduction", Type != "Difference") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Type, names_to = "Feature", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      Type == clusterNTitle ~ clusterNTitle,
      Type == nonClusterNTitle ~ nonClusterNTitle
    ),
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = var_reduced_stats)  # Ensure proper ordering of features
  ) %>% 
  select(-Type)

# Check the structure
head(comparison_data_long)
```

### Plot Polygon Plot for Visual Comparison
```{r, fig.height=7}
ggplot(comparison_data_long, aes(x = Feature, y = Value, group = Group, color = Group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  coord_polar(start = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = -1,
      vjust = -1,
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Comparison of Cluster", clusterN, "vs Non Cluster", clusterN, "Features", sep = " "),
    subtitle = "Polygon Plot (Radar/Spider Chart)",
    x = "Features",
    y = "Values"
  )
```

### Save Variance Reduction Plots for all Clusters to a PDF
```{r}
# Open a PDF device to save all the plots
pdf("cluster_variances.pdf", width = 8, height = 10)

# Loop through clusterN from 1 to 14
for (clusterN in 1:14) {
  
  # Step 1: Grab a single cluster's data
  clusterNScaled <- off_scaled_df %>% 
    filter(FullCluster == clusterN) %>% 
    select(-FullCluster)
  
  # Step 2: Calculate Centered Variance for each feature
  cNVar <- 1 - sapply(clusterNScaled, var)
  
  # Step 3: Sort the variances
  cNVar_sorted <- sort(cNVar, decreasing = FALSE)
  
  # Step 4: Convert to data frame for plotting
  var_df <- data.frame(
    feature = factor(names(cNVar_sorted), levels = names(cNVar_sorted)),
    variance = as.numeric(cNVar_sorted)
  )
  
  # Step 5: Plot the variances for this cluster
  p <- ggplot(var_df, aes(x = feature, y = variance)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue") +
    theme_minimal() +
    ylab("Variance") +
    xlab("Feature") +
    ggtitle(paste("Feature Variances Decreases (Cluster", clusterN, ")")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 10,                    # Label text size
        angle = 0,                    # No rotation
        hjust = 0,                    # Align to the left
        vjust = 0.5,                  # Center vertically
        margin = margin(b = 15)       # Increase space between labels
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1) # Ensure x-axis labels are readable
    )
  
  # Print the plot to the PDF
  print(p)
}

# Close the PDF device
dev.off()
```
